issues.summary: Detect slip from finger-pad sound and tighten the grip (BRK-103)

body.context: Items slide out of the fingers on fast moves before the vision check sees it.
approach: A1: a contact microphone sits under the silicone pad of each finger.
A2: call it a slip when the 2 to 6 kHz band energy from the pad microphone rises above three times its no-motion baseline for 5 ms.
A3: on each slip, raise the grip force by 15 percent, up to a 40 N ceiling.
body.results: Prototype on one finger set; 41 of 50 induced slips caught on the bench.
body.open: No second finger set built yet.

comments.author: Ravi Anand
comments.text: Ceiling of 40 N crushes the soft-fruit SKUs; check before field use.
